decisions.reason: Although it is distant from the core offer and only lightly promoted on the website, it is still a recent launch in an expanding firm and industry, so management is likely to give this invested niche product more time.
This product builds on the firm's lighting capabilities, was given its own page, and fits a plausible institutional-use segment, so public commitment and strategic fit favor continuation.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires are strongly aligned with the firm's industrial customer base, engineering strengths and LED-oriented direction, making withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.

The relaunch of a previously popular task light signals prior investment and visible commitment, which under escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist unless results are clearly bad.
